name: R3-eval-reward-bench
description: R3-eval-reward-bench is a benchmark suite for evaluating reward models used in RLHF or preference modeling. It measures how well reward models align with human judgments by scoring pairwise comparisons, ranking, or rating predictions across evaluation prompts. The benchmark is used to compare reward-model predictive accuracy and correlation with human preferences.
reputation: A niche evaluation dataset aimed at reward-model research and alignment work; modest adoption within that community.
